rows.observation: Name the first, second, and third elements seen.
rows.failure: Attention has no stable entry or reading order.
rows.remediation: Return to composition planning and reduce competing emphasis.

rows.observation: Record body measure, font size, line count, and occupied area.
rows.failure: Copy is over-compressed, under-filled, or outside the family capacity.
rows.remediation: Return to editorial capacity or select another feasible family.

rows.observation: List every chart mark, label, baseline, and encoded variable.
rows.failure: The relationship is ambiguous or visually misleading.
rows.remediation: Return to contract materialization and choose a truthful static encoding.

rows.observation: Compare repeated spacing and type roles against named tokens.
rows.failure: One-off values break rhythm or hierarchy.
rows.remediation: Return to renderer tokens or propose a versioned policy exception.
